r.경제 체제: Nordic welfare-state market economy · pharmaceuticals, wind power, shipping, food
r.주식시장 시가총액: $151.3 billion, 60% of GDP (2004, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.04 for a Big Mac, $0.82 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 104% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Ships 72%, Cars 12%, Machinery, computers 6%, Plastics 3% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Pharmaceuticals 38%, Machinery, computers 15%, Vaccines, blood products 8%, Dairy, eggs, honey 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy and parliamentary system that includes Greenland and the Faroe Islands.

t.why: Home to the shipping giant Maersk and Novo Nordisk, maker of obesity drugs.
t.rel: A kingdom that includes Greenland and the Faroe Islands. In 2025-26, US talk of taking over Greenland caused diplomatic friction with the United States.
t.korea: It sent the hospital ship Jutlandia during the Korean War.
t.know: Denmark's flag is considered the oldest national flag still in use.
t.etext: Strong in pharmaceuticals, wind turbines, shipping, pork and dairy. A drugmaker producing obesity treatments has grown big enough to drive the country's economic growth. A country of high welfare and high taxes.
